about_the_game:
Starfinder 2 RPG - Starfinder Flip-Mat: Derelict Starships


These ships don't sink, they just float forever. Explore the husks of abandoned starships in
Starfinder Flip-Mat: Derelict Starships . One side of this mat recreates a classic starship used by intrepid adventurers across the cosmos, only long-after they've been forced to abandon it. You can even use this side as battle damaged version of the classic starship featured on Starfinder Flip-Mat: Sunrise Maiden. The other side of the mat shows the shorn off section of a larger warship, where active battles could still be taking place! Both sides work as the setting for a full session of exploration in the depths of space.


NOTE: This product has been made specifically for the Starfinder ruleset, but can be used for 5E, Starfinder, or any ruleset supported by Fantasy GroundsThis product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and Features the Following additions:

    All maps are resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage
  • All the images and handouts from the book are available to share with your players as you need them
<br>

" Adapted for Fantasy Grounds by: Christopher Ward
